_comment: Template for ORDS endpoints on the External REST path. Put every workflow-settable value in resourcePath/headers/bodyTemplate as a {token}; tokens become EXTERNAL_REST node inputs, and ORDS binds empty token values as NULL. PL/SQL bodies come from handler source, not the generated spec. See reference/external-rest-endpoints.md
